purpose: Canonical Soldier identity contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer.

canonicalKey.role: Only canonical JOIN key for Soldier identity across the shared relation layer

identityRules: All Hero <-> Soldier relation edges must reference Soldier by soldierId.
Soldier names must never be used as JOIN keys.
siteId, nameKr, nameCn, tier, armyType and uiGroup are presentation, routing, classification or review metadata only.
For a normal Soldier, soldierId is the SoldierInfo ID represented by the canonical Soldier master.
For an SP Soldier, soldierId is SPSoldierInfo.ID and identifies the SP Soldier form itself.
The Normal <-> SP Soldier relationship is defined only by SPSoldierInfo.NormalSoliderId <-> SPSoldierInfo.ID.
normalSoldierId and spSoldierId are relationship metadata and must not replace soldierId as the identity of the current record.
isSp must reflect explicit SP membership/relationship data rather than an inferred numeric ID range.
Numeric offsets such as SP ID = normal ID + 5000 must never be used to infer identity or relationships.
Name similarity, ordering, tier, army type or other presentation fields must never be used to infer Soldier identity.
A relation edge whose soldierId is absent from the canonical Soldier master must fail integrity validation rather than being silently accepted.

siteId.rule: Site/routing identifier only. It must map back to soldierId and must not be used as a ConfigData JOIN key.

siteSoldierId.rule: Do not introduce a second canonical Soldier identifier unless a later site requirement needs it; any future site identifier must map back to soldierId.

spRelationshipContract.recordIdentityRule: Each normal and SP form remains a distinct Soldier record with its own soldierId; the explicit relation links the two forms.

completion: A-2 is complete when all later relation schemas and builders are required to use soldierId as the sole canonical Soldier identity key and Normal/SP form linkage only from the explicit SPSoldierInfo relation.
